problem_type: Missing shared waypoint aiming and batch orientation contract
symptom: Single and batch waypoint inspectors omit approved aim-at-target and independent pitch/roll controls.
direct_cause: The cards expose only raw angles or an all-zero loop; no action samples each target at each waypoint time.
class_root: Waypoint orientation has no common scene-coordinate and transactional batch editing boundary.
internal_only_reason: The approved reference waypoint cards define bake-on-change semantics; this repair only uses existing internal math and store contracts.
invariants: Each selected waypoint aims at target evaluated at its own time
Single target metadata survives normalization; batch does not create dynamic bindings
Batch mutation has one undo boundary and rejects invalid targets or angles
Batch deletion waits for existing confirmation dialog; cancel leaves project unchanged
Object XYZ and camera YXZ baked rotations align their actual +Z forward axis to the evaluated target with zero roll
generality_proof: Both inspector cards call the same scene-aware aiming action and batch orientation action; normalization preserves the optional metadata.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Evaluate source/target in common parent coordinates per waypoint time
Validate target and batch angles, mutate once with shared history

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls shared aim action with rememberTarget
Uses the same action without persisting target metadata

recurrence.reason: Every object/camera and every multi-selection can reach missing interaction
same_class_scan: Read WaypointCard, BatchWaypointsCard, storeTimelineActions, trajectoryEval, directorProject normalization
Read the reference waypoint card behavior and all lookAtObjectId consumers to distinguish baked metadata from dynamic camera rig targets
Independent THREE Euler oracle on objects and cameras exposed 0.11016 forward-vector error for XYZ using YXZ angles; camera passed

prevention.failure_mode: Invalid targets and nonfinite angles return zero without writes
prevention.invariant: All orientation batches use validated scene-aware sampling and one project mutation
prevention.strategy: Two UI entries converge on shared actions

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace old per-point flatten loop with atomic shared batch actions

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal math and existing store/component APIs

migration: Optional lookAtObjectId is preserved when present, absent legacy values remain free orientation.
residual_risks: 9 model regressions passed including independent THREE XYZ/YXZ forward-vector oracle; 9 real-browser cases passed with zero page errors; full desktop J1-J8 integration is owned by the coordinator.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/model/storeTimelineActions.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
